units: <cite ref="Menachot 32b:4">Men. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>צריכות ש׳</he> must be written on traced lines; <cite ref="Megillah 18b:16">Meg. 18ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 75b:2">Sabb. 75ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>המולח והמעבד</he>, <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">ib. VII, 2</cite>) <he>אפיק … ועייל ש׳</he> take out either of the two words, and insert (among the forbidden acts) the tracing of outlines on the hide before cutting.
